#   173, 175 - LocalTZA() is cached in a function-local static per library, so
#              exactly ONE timezone can be exercised per test process. This file
#              pins TZ=America/New_York (row 174, negative offset with DST) and
#              compares every local getter/setter against its UTC twin. Rows 173
